name: PRX-03140
summary: PRX-03140 is an orally-bioavailable selective partial agonist to the 5-Hydroxytryptamine receptor 4 (5-HT4) and a ligand for the Sigma-1 and Sigma-2 receptors. PRX-03140 is a partial agonist (18% relative to 5-HT) of the 5-HT4 receptor that was developed by EPIX Pharmaceuticals for Alzheimer's disease.

pharmacology.text: PRX-03140 is an orally-bioavailable selective partial agonist to the 5-Hydroxytryptamine receptor 4 (5-HT4) and a ligand for the Sigma-1 and Sigma-2 receptors. PRX-03140 is a partial agonist (18% relative to 5-HT) of the 5-HT4 receptor that was developed by EPIX Pharmaceuticals for Alzheimer's disease.

uses.text: PRX-03140 is a partial agonist (18% relative to 5-HT) of the 5-HT4 receptor that was developed by EPIX Pharmaceuticals for Alzheimer's disease. It has been tested in six Phase 1 and Phase 2 clinical trials.

fact.en: Its PRX prefix comes from Predix Pharmaceuticals, later part of EPIX Pharmaceuticals, which tested it as a treatment for Alzheimer's disease.
fact.zh: 它的 PRX 字首來自 Predix 製藥公司，該公司後來併入 EPIX 製藥，並將它作為阿茲海默症的治療藥物進行試驗。
fact.zhHans: 它的 PRX 前缀来自 Predix 制药公司，该公司后来并入 EPIX 制药，并将它作为阿兹海默症的治疗药物进行试验。
